definitions.train: Deterministic continuous real 2010-2017 evaluation; distinct from sampled stochastic episode rewards.
definitions.return_pct: Cumulative net return including entry cost, relative to pre-entry capital=1.
definitions.annual_return_pct: exp(mean daily log returns *252)-1; excludes the initial entry-cost level. Used in legacy-compatible Calmar.
definitions.sharpe: Mean daily log return / sample SD * sqrt(252), rf=0.
definitions.sortino: Mean daily log return / sqrt(mean(min(log return,0)^2)) * sqrt(252).
definitions.mdd_pct: Positive magnitude from daily NAV running maximum.
definitions.es95_daily_pct: Negative mean of simple daily returns <= empirical fifth percentile; losses positive, gains negative.
definitions.horizon21: Overlapping 21-trading-day simple NAV returns within each split. Worst return keeps the return sign; VaR/ES report losses as positive and gains as negative. Overlapping windows are not independent observations.
definitions.fee_factor_drag_pct: 1-product(TRF multipliers including entry); conditional on fixed actions, not a separate optimized no-cost strategy.
definitions.subperiods: Carry existing holdings and policy state. Later subperiod NAV is rebased to the preceding day's NAV; only a split's first subperiod includes entry cost.
definitions.bootstrap: 100000 paired-seed resamples, percentile 95% interval; unadjusted exploratory comparisons, training-seed uncertainty only.
definitions.bands: Across-seed IQR unless stated otherwise; not a confidence interval.

limitations: Validation is used for selection and is therefore optimistic.
All checkpoint test curves are post-selection diagnostics; no test maximum is used to select models.
The old v2/v3 test periods have been inspected previously; these are not a pristine blind holdout.
Legacy v2/v3 have three seeds, legacy TRF training, different fixed-condition generation and runtime; v3 training has zero fees. Common reevaluation does not remove training confounding.
Current generated datasets share one TimeDiff checkpoint and one sampling/noise seed; results do not measure generator-seed uncertainty.
Real replay duplicates preserve matching sampling weights and do not represent extra independent market events.
Generator conditions use original prices; current PPO uses the extended price download, with measured <=1.282 ppm overlap price differences.
